name: BMN 333
sort_evidence: BMN 333 is a long-acting CNP analogue distinct from vosoritide, in a recruiting Phase 2/3 head-to-head against vosoritide in achondroplasia (NCT07441876).

trials.title: Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of BMN 333 Versus Vosoritide in Children With Achondroplasia
